decided: Until orbit can hold a program for one sign-off at its end, a project that sets sign-off to once per program is treated as if sign-off were off, and orbit says once that the value is not read yet. Any other value orbit does not know is treated the same way.
alternatives: refuse to run until the value is changed
treat once per program as signing off at every change's archive
why: This is how orbit already treats a pull request setting it does not know: it falls back to today's behaviour and says so, so nothing waits on a sign-off that cannot happen and the user is told why.
